newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow to raise $5 bln annually from bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Moscow to raise $5 bln annually from bond issues.

text.p: Moscow plans to raise $5 billion annually by issuing Eurobonds, municipal bonds and savings bonds to fund investment projects in the city, the chairman of the Moscow Securities Market Committee said on Tuesday.
Moscow plans to issue municipal bonds similar to GKO discount Treasury bills in November, Mechislav Klimovich told a conference of securities market participants.
Moscow Mayor Yuri Luzhkov and the central bank had advised the city authorities to issue municipal bonds with one year maturity, he said.
Moscow has chosen CS First Boston and Nomura International as lead managers for the issue of its first Eurobond.
